fdef73edb35fc234.description: Position Description: Do you enjoy playing Minecraft and also find coding and teaching fun? At Kodland, you can contribute to children’s creativity, strengthen their problem-solving skills, and help them become creators in the digital world by teaching block-based coding and basic programming concepts through Minecraft: Education Edition . If you are energetic, patient, and enjoy communicating with children, this role is perfect for you! Responsibilities: Deliver fun and interactive Minecraft coding lessons using the provided materials. Help students understand the fundamentals of coding through Microsoft MakeCode . Encourage active participation and keep students motivated throughout the lessons. Collaborate with the Kodland instructor team by sharing feedback and improving lesson quality. Regularly report on student progress. Represent Kodland in a positive manner and creatively contribute to the learning experience.
